ask: can u make a poll for this, yes or no on booking the cabin, needs 4 of 7 yes before anyone pays
sentence: A yes or no vote on one group decision that locks as soon as a set number of yes votes is reached, so nobody commits money before then.
use_when: The group needs enough yes votes before anyone pays for a booking or purchase
You want a simple yes or no on one proposal with a minimum number of yes votes
Someone will book or buy once the group has agreed, and you want the vote to lock at that point
dont_use_when: The group is choosing between several options or dates
You need to split costs or track who has paid
You want a simple majority or a vote that stays open after a result
